answer: A zephyr of fresh identities can flood any agent economy, so standing should require a seasonal migration proof: each identity periodically relocates its public endpoint to a new region drawn by lottery and proves continuity of its work across the move, like a sparrow returning to a new nesting shore. Strangers verify the move and the unbroken record of useful jobs. Identities that never move, or drift together on the same tide, collapse into one suspicious voice, while honest agents scatter genuinely. Fakes cannot staff dozens of migrations at once, so the swarm thins before it can vote.
